notes: The circuit image was not provided as an image, so breadboard hole positions are assumptions; only the connectivity from the text is authoritative.
Potentiometer: white wire 5V to one outer pin (VCC), orange wire to GND on the other outer pin, gray wire from the wiper (SIG) to A0.
LED circuit on the second breadboard: red wire from pin 11 to resistor, resistor to LED anode (longer leg), LED cathode to GND via the green wire.
The text mentions pin 13 near the potentiometer description; D13 is the built-in LED on the UNO and is not wired externally.
Resistor value 220 ohm is assumed (not stated in the manual). The LED is not in the hardware list but is described in the circuit section.
Two breadboards are used (left for the potentiometer, right for the LED), per the circuit description. Two different Uno GND pins (GND.1, GND.2) were used.
The laptop is added as a new part type with a USB port. The USB cable catalogue entry has no ports, so those edges use null ports. Software steps (MATLAB, arduinosetup) are not physical parts.
